title: Rust: SF Assignment hash-based derivation
description: Implement hash-based SF assignment: assigned_sf = 7 + (hash_32(IID) mod 6) using FNV-1a32
close_reason: Fixed: Module sf_assignment existed but was not exported from lib.rs. Added pub mod sf_assignment export and added missing DIO_OPTION_ASSIGNED_SF constant (0x14). The assigned_sf_hash_based function correctly implements 7 + (hash_32(IID) % 6) using FNV-1a32. All 7 tests pass.
